by_rule.description: geospatial collections must include a thumbnail asset (png, jpeg or webp)
a mirror must include a rel:'via' link (type text/html) to the original source
collection IDs should be lowercase [a-z0-9_-], start with a letter, and be unique
every asset should carry file:size and file:checksum
a mirror should link the upstream STAC with rel:'canonical' when one exists
